name: Media
description: Put stored files under the plugin's own permissions, and hand it files it holds.

capabilities.name: Guard a file
capabilities.description: Make a stored file readable only as the plugin's media guard function allows. Maps to kernel command media::protect.

capabilities.name: Release a file
capabilities.description: Take a file the plugin guards out of its guard again. Maps to kernel command media::release.

capabilities.name: Store a file
capabilities.description: Put a file the plugin holds (an attachment fetched from a mail server) into the organization's media, readable only by the person it runs for until the plugin protects it. Maps to kernel command media::store.

capabilities.name: Read a guarded file
capabilities.description: Read the bytes of a stored file the plugin guards. Maps to kernel command media::read.
